svg.title: Kumo Tabular small - classifier
svg.desc: NVIDIA - cell embedding -> column/row blocks -> in-context stack · 27.5 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted); R: rows; C: columns. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input. How to read: × N: the block is stacked N times; its sublayers are drawn once; alternating: Column block and Row block take turns, one of each per repeat, rather than one stack after the other; over rows / columns / features: the axis this block's attention runs across; card colour: what kind of stage it is (see the legend above); right margin: the tensor shape each stage emits, then its exact parameter count; left margin: the phase each group of stages belongs to.
